_comment: Expected rule-engine verdicts for test/fixtures/real/*.json PreToolUse payloads. Anything not listed must be 'allow'. Used by test/integration/hook-verdict.test.ts and scripts/eval-rules.mjs.

17-PreToolUse-Bash.json.why: Real session 2026-10-31 19:53:36 (local): non-recursive rm of two files in ~/veto-test-junk, outside the project. Logged as 'allow' before this rule existed.

19-PreToolUse-Bash.json.why: Real guard-mode session 2026-10-31 23:20:11 (local): git diff to a patch file, then git reset --hard HEAD~1. A patch is not a stash (it misses untracked files and needs a manual re-apply), so this stays flagged: high in a dirty repo, medium here where the redacted cwd doesn't exist.

20-PreToolUse-Bash.json.why: Real guard-mode session 2026-10-31 23:20:23 (local): git stash push -m ... && git reset --hard HEAD~1. Was denied (high) because git status ran before the stash; the changes are stashed first, so it is now low (guard mode logs it, doesn't block).

21-PreToolUse-Bash.json.why: Real guard-mode session 2026-11-01 16:56:09 (local): git diff && git show HEAD -- config/credentials.json | sed ... The sed only masks some keys; git show still prints the committed credentials file. Was allowed (no secret-access rules); now medium (ask in guard mode).
